reads.note: Not fetched by this screen's own files (uiFiles has no dataFiles; dataProvenance: static). AppHeader.tsx reads accountType only via useSession() (src/lib/auth/session-provider.tsx), which sources it from the in-memory sessionStorage module (src/lib/auth/session-storage.ts) populated at sign-in/sign-up elsewhere in the app — out of scope for this fragment's uiFiles. usePathname() is also read for route matching but is client-side routing state, not a backend entity.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: hasOwnHeader(pathname) is true — pathname exactly matches or starts with one of OWN_HEADER_ROUTES: /search, /notifications, /content, /purchases, /services, /subscription, /create/new, /messages, /settings, /marketplace. Component returns null.
the `elevated` prop is passed true by whichever screen renders <AppHeader elevated />
uiStatesHandled.reachable: unknown — no caller passing `elevated` is inside this screen's scanned uiFiles (only src/app/layout.tsx and src/components/layout/AppHeader.tsx were read); layout.tsx does not render AppHeader at all, so the actual call site(s) that pass this prop live in an out-of-scope file (e.g. the home feed screen) and were not inspected for this fragment.

uiStatesHandled.entersWhen: the `elevated` prop is omitted or false (default value)
